message: The weaver type '{0}' required to weave aspect '{1}' is not found in the project. Make sure that the project references the assembly that defines this weaver, and that the weaver type is annotated with [MetalamaPlugIn].
rationale: The message gives no way forward. AspectDriverFactory.GetAspectDriver returns an ErrorAspectWeaver when no loaded plug-in (a type annotated with [MetalamaPlugIn] in a compile-time assembly of the project or its references) has the full name required by [RequireAspectWeaver], so the two obvious fixes are a missing reference and a missing [MetalamaPlugIn] attribute.
codeChange: ErrorAspectWeaver.TransformAsync reports the error with a null location, so it appears without a file in the error list. It could be reported on the aspect class or on one of the aspect instances in context.AspectInstances.
